name: anti-hall
description: Verify-first guardrails for Claude Code: hooks that block made-up APIs, force-push, AI commit credit and unverified "done" claims.

auto_handover_enabled.title: Auto Handover · Enabled
auto_handover_enabled.description: Write an automatic session handover before context runs out. All other settings: /anti-hall:settings.

auto_handover_pct.title: Auto Handover · Threshold %
auto_handover_pct.description: Context-usage percent that triggers an automatic handover.

limit_conserve_mode.title: Limit Conservation · Mode
limit_conserve_mode.description: Force usage-limit conservation on/off, or auto-detect. Allowed: auto | on | off.

jev_enabled.title: Jev · Enabled
jev_enabled.description: Enable the opt-in Jev semantic decision engine.

jev_api_key.title: Jev · API key (legacy, one vendor)
jev_api_key.description: LEGACY generic key, kept so existing setups keep working. Legacy; bound to the vendor in jev.genericKeyVendor (home settings only, default vercel) and never sent to any other vendor, whatever jev.transport is. Prefer the vendor-named keys below. Stored in the OS credential store; anti-hall reads it only from here unless the jev.allowLegacyKeyRead setting is on.

jev_vercel_api_key.title: Jev · Vercel AI Gateway key
jev_vercel_api_key.description: Your Vercel AI Gateway key. Sent only to the Vercel AI Gateway, whichever transport is primary or fallback. Stored in the OS credential store.

jev_typesafe_api_key.title: Jev · TypeSafe key
jev_typesafe_api_key.description: Your TypeSafe API key. Sent only to the TypeSafe API, whichever transport is primary or fallback. Stored in the OS credential store.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic · API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Your Anthropic API key, used only by the opt-in semantic speculation judge and the Haiku fallback of Jev message triage. Stored in the OS credential store.

devswarm_supervisor_mode.title: DevSwarm · Supervisor mode
devswarm_supervisor_mode.description: Force the DevSwarm supervisor context on/off, or auto-detect. Allowed: auto | on | off.

guards_model_routing.title: Guards · Model-routing guard mode
guards_model_routing.description: model-routing-guard (PreToolUse Agent/Task): strict blocks a mis-tiered spawn, advisory only warns, off disables the hook. Allowed: strict | advisory | off.

safety_git_guard.title: Safety Guards · git-guard (force-push / AI credit)
safety_git_guard.description: git-guard: block force-push and AI self-credit in commits and gh pr/issue/release bodies. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_command_guard.title: Safety Guards · command-guard (heavy-command delegation)
safety_command_guard.description: command-guard core: make the coordinator delegate heavy commands (build/test/deploy/push). Its data-safety sub-guards (DevSwarm read/send/mailbox, armed stash guard) stay on. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_edit_guard.title: Safety Guards · edit-guard (edit delegation)
safety_edit_guard.description: edit-guard core: make the coordinator delegate file edits outside its own plan/state/handover files. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.

safety_swarm_guard.title: Safety Guards · swarm-guard (spawn-rate / memory)
safety_swarm_guard.description: swarm-guard: block agent spawns past the spawn-rate cap or under critical memory pressure. Safety guard: only you can change it (here or via env); agents cannot.
